# Memmy v1.1.6

## Highlights

- Added resident capture, policy-controlled recording, prose summaries, and replayable history views.
- Improved native MCP packaging, permission onboarding, and cross-platform screen actions.
- Improved packaged Memory, source scanning, model configuration, and skill deduplication.
- Removed upload count and size limits and switched document processing to a manifest.
- Preserved runtime dependencies and fixed candidate-build, verification, and native-asset issues.
- Fixed startup handoff, login UI, layout, and platform-permission behavior.
- Fixed release-related build reproducibility and integration checks.

## Upgrade notes

- Memmy Desktop and Agent are version `1.1.6`.
- The bundled Memory service, viewer, and CLI remain independently versioned.
- Memory protocol version remains `1`.
